name: drawir
description: Vector intermediate representation (DXF / Visio / Figma / draw.io / Sketch / SVG) and pluggable renderers (canvas / svg / html / meta2d)

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/parser/dxf packages/parser/visio packages/parser/drawio packages/parser/figma packages/parser/sketch packages/parser/svg packages/render/core packages/render/canvas packages/render/svg packages/render/html packages/render/meta2d && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: tsc -b packages/core packages/parser/dxf packages/parser/visio packages/parser/drawio packages/parser/figma packages/parser/sketch packages/parser/svg packages/render/core packages/render/canvas packages/render/svg packages/render/html packages/render/meta2d --clean && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
